formal_statement.plain_language: The printed four-stage Method 4s3pC coefficients satisfy third-order consistency and every nontrivial simplified smooth-perturbation condition to their decimal print precision, while the corresponding nonsmooth absolute condition is definitively nonzero.

informal_proof: Expand the four-stage matrices, derive c and c^epsilon from their row sums, and evaluate the finite dot and matrix-vector products over the printed decimal coefficients. Each consistency and smooth-condition residual is below 2e-15. The absolute nonsmooth expression evaluates above 1/100, so it cannot satisfy the required zero condition.
informal_statement: A print-precision coefficient certificate for Method 4s3pC: third-order consistency and simplified smooth perturbation conditions hold, but the stricter nonsmooth condition fails.
